metadata.coordinate_catalog: data/cities_sl.json; eight city centres; zero elevation for the stated flat-horizon model

reference_sources.name: Astronomsko društvo Orion, Igor Žiberna, 6. avgust 2026

metadata.precision: Rounded to the nearest minute in the interface; calculated estimates, not measured observing conditions.
metadata.horizon: Flat unobstructed horizon, zero elevation, standard refraction and upper-limb rise/set; mountains, buildings and weather excluded.
metadata.lunar_contacts: Contact times are symmetric about maximum using Astronomy Engine semi-durations; independent reference error under 90 seconds.
metadata.meteor_peak: No exact annual peak predicted. August 11/12, 12/13 and 13/14 are planning nights, not an annual maximum ephemeris.
